segments.text: Nourish, a self-hosted recipe app built for families who love to cook together.
Import recipes from URLs or let AI fill in the details when needed. It even supports video recipe imports from Tik Tok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts. One
shared place to collect all your recipes, fully synced in real time.
Whether you're meal planning side by side or doing groceries across the store, Nourish updates instantly so everyone knows who grabbed
